work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Epistle CXCVI to King Otto of Greece (address LF34143–34144, protocol LF34147, salutation LF34150–34151) congratulates him on his accession, exhorts him to defend the Catholic faith, imparts the blessing and ends with its own 21 January 1833 closing at LF34190. Its provenance note 2 (Ex Archivio Brevium ad Principes) follows at LF34193 and the page number at LF34196–34198, before numeral CXCVII at LF34201. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF34147–34147; the source closing at LF34187–34190 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima prima januarii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo tertio, pontificatus No- stri anno secundo, Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
